mod.spatial-gui.name: Spatial GUI
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.title: Spatial GUI Config
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.first: Use first person camera mode for the inventory screen
Use first person camera mode for non-inventory screens
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.autoD: Automatically detect camera mode from current perspective
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.autoC: Automatically calculate the GUI scale based on window height
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.guiSc: Manual GUI scale when Auto Calculate is disabled (1-6)
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.pause: Enable Spatial GUI for the pause menu
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.allSc:
Enable Spatial GUI for every other screen while in a world
WARNING: EXPERIMENTAL
If a modded screen is broken, put it in disabled screens
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.inven: Enable for the survival and creative inventory
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.conta:
Enable for chests, furnaces, crafting tables, villager trading, etc.
Includes most modded ones
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.autoS: Automatically adjust screen scale, distance, and side offset based on your FOV setting
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.mirro: Mirror the camera and screen position/rotation in third person mode
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.hudOp: Hide the hotbar when a screen is open
Hide HUD elements (including the hotbar) when a screen is open
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.autoF: FOV value that results in no scaling adjustment
Reduces the effect of FOV scaling on side offset
Adjusts the effect of FOV scaling on camera distance
Auto Scale Third Person Screen Multiplier
Reduces FOV scaling effect on third person screen scale
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.filte: Enable anisotropic filtering for better texture quality
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.recip: Amount to shrink the screen when recipe book is open
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.first: Hide player hands when in first person mode
Hide the players shield when in first person mode
Swing the player's arm when clicking items in first person mode
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.rende:
Resolution scale for the GUI (25-100%).
Lower values improve performance, but look worse visually.
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.blurW:
Blurs the world behind the spatial screen, keeping the hand, HUD and player model sharp
EXPERIMENTAL
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.world:
How strong the blur of the world behind the screen is (1-10)
EXPERIMENTAL
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.scree: Distance of the screen from the player

Scale multiplier for the screen
WARNING: Values too large may cause mouse tracking to fail
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.camer: Horizontal offset from the player (-4 to 4)
Vertical offset from the player (-4 to 4)
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.trans: Duration of the camera transition animation
Skip percentage of transition to avoid clipping
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.avata: Base yaw offset for the player avatars head
Rotation offset for the player avatar's body
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.lerpX: Smoothly interpolate camera pitch during transition
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.fallb: Fallback to First Person on Block Collision

Switch to first-person mode if third-person camera is obstructed by blocks.
When disabled, camera distance is adjusted to avoid clipping into blocks.
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.lerpC:
Lerp the camera pitch.
Only when opening from Minecraft's third person perspective
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.first: Screen horizontal offset from the camera
Screen vertical offset from the camera

Scale multiplier for the screen
WARNING: Values too large may cause mouse tracking to fail
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.curve:
Render the first person screen as a semi-cylinder wrapping around the camera
EXPERIMENTAL

Total arc angle of the curved screen (5-150).
Higher values wrap the screen further around the camera
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.keepF:
Keep the camera angle when closing the GUI
WARNING: This affects your server-side rotation 
and may be disallowed by servers
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.inher: When a screen opens another screen, the new screen keeps the previous screen position instead of following your in-screen look direction
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.useCr: Use the in-game crosshair position for mouse interaction instead of the actual mouse cursor
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.lockF: Limit how far the first person camera can turn side to side to 180 degrees
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.first: Maximum pitch angle for first person screen spawning
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.enabl: Enable fade animation when opening inventory screens
Enable scale animation when opening inventory screens
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.anima: Starting scale as percentage of final scale
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.overr: Override the game's FOV when a screen is open
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.targe: Target FOV value when override is enabled (30-110)
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.fovLe: Speed of FOV transition (0 is instant, higher is slower)
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.seenS:
Class names of every screen you've opened.
Copy a name from here into Enabled Screens or Disabled Screens.
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.enabl:
Full class names of other screens to show as a 3D plane.
Works with modded screens.
Does not override the Inventory, Containers or Pause Screen toggles.
text.autoconfig.spatial-gui.option.disab:
Full class names of screens that should never use Spatial GUI.
This takes priority over everything else.
